# Neofetch mod for Minecraft

This mod adds a fetch command into Minecraft that gives report about version, position, game time, number of mods, and other stuffs

## Officially discontinuated

Visiting this project after a few inactive years, I have decided to officially discontinue the mod for good:

1. lihugang has made a complete, working equivalent mod anyways. Check out: [lihugang/mcfetch](https://github.com/lihugang/mcfetch)
2. This mod is really never going to be complete.
3. I ran out of Minecraft mod ideas.
